title: V1-06F independent Domain terminal-recovery archive review

roles.independence: Reviewer did not edit or import product/test code, execute workers, or rerun pytest in this review. The standalone stdlib checker is reviewer-authored; its own negative checks are not independent product tests.

findings: Domain fixture registers the existing SchedulingDomain and uses real public IdeaLake.insert admission in a private CPU project.

The prepare and interpret wrappers call the captured original Domain methods. Native READY instrumentation calls the original prepare_supervised, records its binding, and performs owned STOP if recording fails; it does not supply worker results or closure.

The crash callback checks the exact current TERMINAL, effect scan, BOUND reservation, absent task effect guard and no transaction before os._exit(86). Evaluator exit0 is distinct from controller exit86.

Recovery and repeated idle controllers set ORZE_F_RECOVERY_DOMAIN_NO_CALLBACKS=1; the test's Domain wrappers raise if invoked. No new native READY or interpretation event appears, and original task/attempt/artifact/observation rows and files remain unchanged.

A valid v1 observation and an invalid v2 observation both belong to successfully completed evaluator executions. v2 capacity_overload carries no value; this is not worker failure and does not trigger scientific re-evaluation during settlement.
No blocking contradiction found within the supported confirmed-terminal, no-Stop metadata-recovery boundary.
source_review.archive_observability_limit: domain_events is a final log, not a per-snapshot event log, and call records do not persist their environment. The archive alone proves consistency with exactly two recorded READY/interpret pairs and unchanged execution state; explicit callback prohibition additionally relies on the frozen actual test's environment/raise guards, not an invented per-call environment attestation.

sha=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
pre={p:sha(p) for p in paths}
ns=runpy.run_path(paths[0],run_name='offline_checker_validation')
base=json.loads(Path(paths[1]).read_bytes()); other=json.loads(Path(paths[2]).read_bytes())
class MemoryReport:
 def __init__(self,record):self.raw=json.dumps(record).encode()
 def read_bytes(self):return self.raw
 def __str__(self):return '<in-memory-negative-not-an-execution-report>'
def record_change(r,shot,table,field,value,index=0):
 row=r['snapshots'][shot]['database'][table][index];obj=json.loads(row['record_json']);obj[field]=value;row['record_json']=json.dumps(obj)
def summary_change(r,field,value):
 row=r['snapshots'][9]['database']['cpu_action_recovery'][0];obj=json.loads(row['summary_json']);obj[field]=value;row['summary_json']=json.dumps(obj)
cases=[]
def add(name,mutator,source=base):
 r=copy.deepcopy(source);mutator(r);cases.append((name,r))
add('controller_no_real_closure',lambda r:r['calls'][2]['controller_closure'].__setitem__('event','STOP_REQUESTED'))
add('native_ready_missing',lambda r:r['domain_events'][0]['binding']['worker'].__setitem__('start_ticks',1))
add('extra_domain_callback',lambda r:r['domain_events'].append({'event':'interpret','operation':'evaluate'}))
add('duplicate_controller_birth',lambda r:r['calls'][3].__setitem__('controller_binding',copy.deepcopy(r['calls'][2]['controller_binding'])))
add('observation_wrong_evaluator',lambda r:record_change(r,7,'research_observations','evaluator',{'task_id':'foreign','phase':'action','generation':1,'attempt_id':'foreign'}))
add('invalid_observation_has_value',lambda r:record_change(r,7,'research_observations','values',{'direction':'maximize','instance_sha256':json.loads(r['snapshots'][7]['database']['research_observations'][0]['record_json'])['values']['instance_sha256'],'value':30}),other)
add('retired_observation_rewritten',lambda r:record_change(r,9,'research_observations','name','changed'))
add('artifact_bytes_changed',lambda r:next(iter(r['snapshots'][9]['files'].values())).__setitem__('utf8','changed'))
add('recovery_summary_bool_schema',lambda r:summary_change(r,'schema',True))
add('recovery_wrong_scope',lambda r:r['snapshots'][9]['database']['cpu_action_recovery'][0].__setitem__('scope','/foreign'))
add('recovery_wrong_nonce',lambda r:r['snapshots'][9]['database']['cpu_action_recovery'][0].__setitem__('nonce','z'*48))
add('budget_refunded',lambda r:r['snapshots'][9]['database']['cpu_action_reservations'][1].__setitem__('permit_json',r['snapshots'][9]['database']['cpu_action_reservations'][1]['permit_json'].replace('2000000000','0')))
add('new_go_during_recovery',lambda r:r['snapshots'][9]['database']['execution_attempts'].append(copy.deepcopy(r['snapshots'][9]['database']['execution_attempts'][0])))
rejected=[]
for name,record in cases:
 try:ns['one'](MemoryReport(record))
 except (AssertionError,KeyError,ValueError,TypeError):rejected.append(name)
 else:raise AssertionError('checker accepted '+name)
post={p:sha(p) for p in paths};assert pre==post
print(json.dumps({'classification':'checker-only in-memory negative inputs, not product tests or execution reports','negative_cases':len(cases),'rejected':rejected,'files_pre_post_exact':pre},sort_keys=True))

assertions_covered: Four fresh CLI worker PID/start_ticks identities per report, exact command modes, controller closure bindings and ECHILD_WALL, start/crash-or-finish marker consistency and monotonic intervals.
Two distinct native READY identities per report, full action AttemptRefs and source DB, completed/return0 terminals, unchanged lifecycle, exact effect PREPARED plan and COMMITTED hash linkage.
Original producer artifact full record, recorded content bytes/size/SHA, evaluator captured source snapshot including original full-row SHA/effect SHA and DB/scope identities.
Observation evaluator full Ref, per-input producer/spec/hash bindings, current evaluator result artifact, publication metadata, valid/value30 versus invalid/capacity_overload/no-value fields.

Strict crash boundary evidence and old evaluator BOUND reservation; only BOUND to SETTLED plus terminal hash is changed, original permit/ref/reservation preserved and four reserved seconds remain charged per report.
Recovery-only and idle snapshots preserve original business DB rows and all recorded artifact/effect bytes; two new Wait/queue_empty decisions are allowed, no Execute is recorded.
Single COMPLETE recovery row with exact scope and budget binding, 48-hex nonce, exact five-field summary, and identical nonce/summary on the subsequent idle controller.
All JSON rejects duplicate keys/nonfinite constants; comparison distinguishes bool from int; -O is explicitly refused. No embedded filesystem path is opened.

historical_loss.explanation: Pytest temporary retention removed the two /tmp5045 files before archival. The reviewer never fully read or cached them. No reconstruction was attempted. This report verifies separately generated target /tmp5046 archives, not replacements for the lost first epoch.

limits: This is recorded consistency checking, not independent cryptographic attestation or new execution authority. No live process, pidfd, lock or database is consulted.

The checker does not independently re-evaluate arbitrary scheduling inputs or claim scientific validity was recomputed during recovery. It checks the fixed v1/v2 output/observation fields and their provenance.
Successful terminal recovery does not adopt an uncertain controller/tree, clear Stop/HOLD, recreate PreparedSources or DomainRun capabilities, rerun GO, or refund reservations.
Thirteen mutated in-memory reports and the -O refusal are checker-only controls, not additional pytest cases, actual corrupted research runs, historical product reds, or a full security proof.
Recorded CLI wall totals include this fixture's actual controller subprocess invocation interval. No CPU efficiency, overhead decomposition, ASR gain or statistical independence is claimed.
Parent's 41-case target footer is reference-bound; reviewer independently executed only offline commands. Final Core/Pro full-suite status is not claimed here.
